name: 30 Pack - 30x1g Pre-roll - Jokerz 31
description:
Thirty joints, one box. The 30 Pack Jokerz 31 gives you thirty full-gram pre-rolls — 30 grams total — rolled with quality flower and ready to smoke. No grinding, no rolling, no running out. Just grab one and go.

Jokerz 31 is a standout indica-leaning hybrid bred by Compound Genetics, born from crossing White Runtz with Jet Fuel Gelato. Expect that signature candy-gas profile: sweet Runtz-style fruit and cream up front, cut with peppery spice, earthy pine, and a bold fuel finish. The effect is heavy and deeply relaxing — a mellow, mood-lifting calm that eases the body and makes it a strong pick for evenings and winding down. 
Noa Botanicals

Why you'll love it:

30 × 1G pre-rolls — 30 grams total, serious value in one box
Ready to smoke — no grinding, no rolling, no setup
Signature Jokerz 31 flavor — sweet candy fruit with peppery spice and a bold gas finish
Relaxing indica-leaning effects — mellow and soothing, ideal for evenings

Big value, dependable quality, and everyday convenience in every box. The 30 Pack Jokerz 31 is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
